{{Hatnote|This is the dated constructed pool of May – September 2012. For the fixed pre-reset pool played since 2014, see [[Legacy Open]]. For all pools of this era, see [[Virtual Legacy#Constructed pools|Virtual Legacy]].}}
'''Premiere - Virtual Block 8.1''' is the constructed card pool of every Decipher card plus the [[Players Committee]] virtual cards through [[Scoundrels (Virtual Block 8)|Virtual Block 8.1: Scoundrels]]. The 8.1 PDF has official text as of 11 May 2012.<ref name="pdf81">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf ''Virtual Block 8: Scoundrels''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of May 11, 2012". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020185537/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf?copy=2 Internet Archive]</ref> No release post or tournament-legal date was found. Decklists of the [[2012 US Nationals]] (8–10 June 2012) already use 8.1 cards such as [[Bane Malar, Spice Addict]] and [[Boba Fett, Prepared Hunter]].<ref name="ev-2012 US Nationals">Decklists of the [[2012 US Nationals]] on this wiki.</ref> The pool lasted until Virtual Block 8.2, released on 20 September 2012, became legal; that date is unknown.<ref name="hp201209">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (Latest News list: "September CBT Changes", 14 September 2012; "8.2 Released!", 20 September 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120930100132/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 30 September 2012]</ref> The Players Committee's name for its constructed format until 2014 was ''Standard'': the 25 July 2014 announcement that replaced this pool was titled "Reset of Standard Format" and said that "The new Standard tournament format will consist of all post-reset V Cards".<ref name="reset">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format], Players Committee, Advocate Council (byline darkjediknight11) (25 July 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20141020142523/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/reset-of-standard-format/ Internet Archive]</ref> "Legacy" was created only then, for the pre-reset cards.

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Players Committee
* '''Card pool:''' every Decipher card plus Virtual Blocks 1–7 and Virtual Block 8.1
* '''In use:''' May 2012 (official text 11 May; legal date unknown, in use by 8 June) – September 2012
* '''GEMP:''' none (GEMP's ''Legacy'' environment is the later fixed pool, [[Legacy Open]])

== Card pool ==
The pool is every Decipher card plus every Players Committee virtual release up to and including [[Scoundrels (Virtual Block 8)|8.1 Scoundrels]]:

* Every card printed by Decipher.
* The earlier numbered Virtual Sets 1–17, including [[Virtual Set: Defensive Shields|Defensive Shields]], as realigned in 2009 into [[Virtual Block 1|Virtual Blocks 1–5]].<ref name="vb1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf ''Virtual Block 1''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="w-reorg">[[2009 Virtual Block Reorganization]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)|6.1 Reflections IV]] (110 cards).<ref name="w-r4">[[Reflections IV (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf61">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf ''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of September 4, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Seventeen of the Legacy [[Virtual Shields]] were printed in this release.<ref name="vshields">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf vshields.pdf], Players Committee (2013). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180941/https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/vshields.pdf Internet Archive]; see [[Virtual Shields]]</ref>
* [[Virtual Block 6]] release [[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)|6.2 Domain Of Evil]] (26 cards).<ref name="w-doe">[[Domain Of Evil (Virtual Block 6)]]</ref><ref name="pdf62">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf ''Virtual Block 6: Domain Of Evil''] (PDF), Players Committee, res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks. Cover: "Official text as of December 7, 2009". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

== History ==
Scoundrels opened Block 8 with 49 cards (25 Dark Side, 24 Light Side).<ref name="w-sc" /> Its announcement on 14 April 2012 set the theme as "those who live on the fringe".<ref name="j335">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=335&catid=1&Itemid=117 Scoundrels 8.1 Annoucement], Players Committee (14 April 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120818111311/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=335&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>

On 29 June 2012 the Players Committee announced 8.2 for 19 July "(and will be tournament legal 1 week thereafter, July 26th—just in time for Continentals)".<ref name="j339">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=339&catid=1&Itemid=117 Virtual Set 8.2 announcement], Players Committee (29 June 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120818111316/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=339&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref> A "Change to virtual set 8.2 release date" followed on 6 July, a "v8.2 Preview Spoiler List" on 14 July and a "4-card Virtual Set 8.2 Preview!" on 20 July 2012.<ref name="hp201208">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org home page], Players Committee (Latest News list: "Change to virtual set 8.2 release date", 6 July 2012; "v8.2 Preview Spoiler List", 14 July 2012; "4-card Virtual Set 8.2 Preview!", 20 July 2012; "An announcement on V8.2", 8 August 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120828093455/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Internet Archive, 28 August 2012]</ref> On 8 August the Players Committee said it would hold back some 8.2 spoilers so it could "use data from the Euro Championship and Nationals to tweak some of the meta cards".<ref name="j343">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=343&catid=1&Itemid=117 An announcement on V8.2], Players Committee (8 August 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120818111339/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=343&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref> Whether the four 8.2 preview cards were tournament legal before 8.2 itself is not known.
